reviews.title: Latest update
reviews.text:
I’m really not a fan of the newest update. I absolutely loved this app and used it every single day for both my tattoo business account and my personal Instagram. One of the main reasons I chose this app, and happily paid for it, was its simplicity. It was the perfect tool for organising my feed and quickly applying beautiful presets. I even had several favourite presets that I used consistently.

Unfortunately, this update has completely changed what made the app so enjoyable. It now feels much more like a full photo editing app rather than the simple layout and preset app I originally downloaded. The interface feels far more complicated and cluttered, and I can no longer find the straightforward workflow that made it such a pleasure to use.

I understand that some people may love the new update, and I appreciate that apps need to evolve, but for me it has lost the features that made it stand out. Sadly, I’m now looking for an alternative because it no longer meets the needs I originally subscribed for.

I genuinely hope the developers consider bringing back the previous layout or at least offering a classic mode, because this was my favourite app and one I was more than happy to pay for. As it stands, I’m unfortunately considering cancelling my subscription.

Where’s the crop tool with actual aspect ratio numbers? Why is it just “Facebook post” and “Instagram story”? Where did the filters go? Why remove features people actually used?

I’ve recommended Preview to everyone I know for years, but this update completely ruined the app for me. If this isn’t changed back, I think you’re going to lose a lot of users.

Sadly, after years of loving it, I’m deleting the app and looking for a new one.
